description: Search live US nursing and allied-health job openings by location, role, specialty, shift, pay and requirements. Data is refreshed daily from employer career sites. Each result has a one-line summary, structured pay, a listing_url to show the person, and an apply_url that goes straight to the employer.

compact_license.description: Only jobs that mention accepting a compact (multistate) nursing license.

employment_type.description: full_time, part_time, prn (per diem), contract, travel, temporary, internship.

first_seen_after.description: Only jobs that first appeared on ScrubShifts on or after this ISO time. For recurring checks, pass the previous response's data_as_of to get just the new jobs.

max_years_experience.description: The person's years of experience; excludes jobs that state a higher minimum.

min_hourly.description: Minimum hourly pay in USD; matches jobs whose listed range reaches it. Implies has_pay.

near.description: Where the person wants to work: "City, ST", a 5-digit ZIP, or "lat,lng". Results are sorted by distance.

new_grad.description: Only jobs open to new graduates (residencies, 'new grads welcome', no experience required).

offset.description: Pagination offset; use next_offset from the previous response.

posted_after.description: Only jobs the employer posted on or after this ISO date/time.

posted_within_days.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days.

q.description: Free-text words that must appear in the title, employer or location, e.g. an employer name.

radius_miles.description: Search radius around near, default 30, max 200.

role.description: Role slug or common name, comma-separated for several: rn, lpn, cna, nurse_practitioner, crna, physical_therapist, respiratory_therapist, medical_assistant, … (see list_filters).

setting.description: Care setting: hospital, clinic, skilled_nursing, home_health, hospice, dialysis_center, telehealth, urgent_care, school, correctional, ambulatory_surgery.

sort.description: best (default): +2 if pay is listed, -1 per week since posting, -1 per 10 miles. Or newest, pay, distance (default when near is set). No paid placement affects ordering.

specialty.description: Unit or specialty, comma-separated: icu, emergency, labor_delivery, nicu, med_surg, telemetry, operating_room, oncology, psych, pediatrics, home_health, hospice, dialysis, … Common words like ER, L&D, tele, peds work.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. CO. Use instead of near for a statewide search.

name: search_jobs
title: Search healthcare jobs
